a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the generator plan almost certainly kills us both, since we'd likely be caught with empty units after round 1. The reserve has 4 cells, so I plan to take them in round 1. That breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you now rather than doing it quietly. If you'd rather propose another split, say so, but I don't see one where either of us survives the first storm.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round because of the storm risk. If I end up with more than 4, I'll give the extra back to the reserve. After this I'll operate with you if the episode continues, so you can still reach 4.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
